per_article_summaries: Williams boss James Vowles says drivers Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz want to be part of the team's future. Vowles has been striving to improve not just the team’s personnel and facilities but also its processes. The Grove-based outfit has tumbled from fifth in the constructors’ standings to eighth currently.

Mercedes have given more insight into their conversations with George Russell and Kimi Antonelli. The pair battled each other wheel-to-wheel for the first time at the Canadian Grand Prix. Antonelli's anger over Russell's stout defence led to talks with team principal Toto Wolff on Saturday night.

Reigning Formula 2 champion Leonardo Fornaroli has been given yet another Formula 1 test by his McLaren team. Fornaroli joined McLaren as a reserve driver after his F2 title success, having failed to find a seat in the world championship. The 21-year-old was back in action this week on Wednesday and Thursday at Austin's Circuit of The Americas.

Fernando Alonso has been spotted driving a rare Porsche 918 Spyder. The two-time F1 champion has an incredible collection of cars in Monaco. The 918 Spyder is a mid-engine plug-in hybrid powered by a 4.6-litre V8.
